Privacy Policy

[To finalize before launch — aligned to the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).]

What we collect. Email addresses you submit for downloads and the newsletter; names and contact details you submit on the consultation and contact forms; standard, privacy-light website analytics.

How we use it. To deliver what you requested, to send guidance you subscribed to, and to respond to your enquiries. We do not sell personal data.

Your rights. You may unsubscribe at any time and may request access to or deletion of your data by writing to info@propertynrentconsult.com.
